trip.understood: I understood: you landed from {origin} and need a flight to {destination}.
trip.not_live: Live flight lookups are not switched on, so I cannot check those flights. Pick your flights from today's schedule.
trip.none_in: I could not find a matching flight from {origin} into Dubai today.
trip.none_out: I could not find a matching flight from Dubai to {destination} today.
trip.outbound: {flight} to {destination} departs {time} from terminal {terminal}. The gate is not assigned yet.
trip.pick: Which of these is yours? Tell me the flight number and I will check the gate and the way there.
